publicMeta.method: Physical damage, operational effect, actor claim and analytic significance are separate fields. Unverified claims remain unverified. Assessment labels describe functional consequence, not moral or political judgment. Routes marked schematic represent published corridors, not live AIS tracks or tactical movement.

balance.note: Project analytic model, not an objective war score. Current ledger: U.S./aligned coalition 3.0 composite; Iran/aligned state forces -1.25. Coalition advantage is strongest in air/long-range strike and C2ISR; Iran's strongest leverage remains maritime disruption/sea denial.

coalition14.name: Saudi Arabia
coalition14.political_context: Absolute monarchy; GCC; major U.S. security partner.
coalition14.religious_context: Sunni-majority; Islam is central to state identity.
coalition14.role: Founding and leading state; hosts coalition command/HQ; Saudi rear admiral appointed commander.

coalition14.name: Kuwait
coalition14.political_context: Constitutional hereditary emirate; GCC; U.S. security partner.
coalition14.religious_context: Muslim-majority; Sunni majority with a substantial Shia minority.

coalition14.name: Bahrain
coalition14.political_context: Hereditary constitutional monarchy; GCC; close U.S. security partner.
coalition14.religious_context: Muslim-majority; Shia-majority citizen population under a Sunni ruling family.

coalition14.name: Qatar
coalition14.political_context: Hereditary emirate; GCC; major U.S. security partner and mediator.
coalition14.role: Founding signatory/member; diplomatic and maritime-security role.

coalition14.name: Pakistan
coalition14.political_context: Federal parliamentary Islamic republic; defense partner of Saudi Arabia and Türkiye.
coalition14.religious_context: Sunni Muslim-majority with a significant Shia minority.
coalition14.role: Founding signatory/member; slated to provide the coalition first deputy commander.

coalition14.name: Türkiye
coalition14.political_context: Presidential republic; NATO member; regional defense-industrial power.
coalition14.religious_context: Constitutionally secular; population overwhelmingly Muslim, mostly Sunni.
coalition14.role: Founding signatory/member; naval, defense-industrial and planning contributor.

coalition14.name: Egypt
coalition14.political_context: Presidential republic; major Arab state; U.S. security partner.
coalition14.religious_context: Sunni Muslim-majority with a large Coptic Christian minority.
coalition14.role: Founding signatory/member; Red Sea/Suez strategic stakeholder.

coalition14.name: Jordan
coalition14.political_context: Constitutional monarchy; close U.S. security partner.
coalition14.role: Founding signatory/member; regional security and air-defense stakeholder.

coalition14.name: Yemen (PLC)
coalition14.political_context: Internationally recognized Presidential Leadership Council; opposed to Houthi control of Sanaa.
coalition14.religious_context: Substantial Shafi’i Sunni and Zaidi Shia communities.
coalition14.role: Founding signatory/member; Arabian-side Bab el-Mandeb stakeholder and anti-Houthi government actor.

coalition14.name: Bangladesh
coalition14.religious_context: Sunni Muslim-majority with Hindu and other minorities.

coalition14.name: Nigeria
coalition14.political_context: Federal presidential republic; major African state.
coalition14.religious_context: Religiously mixed, with large Muslim and Christian populations.
coalition14.role: Listed by Saudi Press Agency among the July 30 founding signatories; current accession roster requires reconciliation with later reporting.

coalition14.name: Sudan
coalition14.political_context: Wartime state; SAF-aligned authorities operate from Port Sudan while civil war continues.
coalition14.role: Founding signatory/member; Red Sea littoral state.

coalition14.name: Djibouti
coalition14.political_context: Presidential republic; hosts multiple foreign military presences.
coalition14.role: Founding signatory/member; immediate Bab el-Mandeb/Horn maritime stakeholder.

coalition14.name: Somalia
coalition14.political_context: Federal republic; internationally recognized federal government.
coalition14.role: Founding signatory/member; Gulf of Aden/Horn maritime stakeholder.

verifiers.name: United Kingdom
verifiers.political_context: Constitutional monarchy; NATO member; UN Security Council permanent member.
verifiers.religious_context: Religiously plural and highly secular; Christian historical heritage.
verifiers.role: Proposed contributor to a third-party Hezbollah-disarmament verification mechanism.

verifiers.name: Italy
verifiers.political_context: Parliamentary republic; NATO and EU member.
verifiers.role: Proposed contributor to a third-party Hezbollah-disarmament verification mechanism.

verifiers.name: Switzerland
verifiers.religious_context: Religiously mixed and increasingly secular; major Catholic and Protestant communities.
verifiers.role: Proposed contributor to a third-party Hezbollah-disarmament verification mechanism.

verifiers.name: Indonesia
verifiers.political_context: Presidential republic; ASEAN and OIC member.
verifiers.religious_context: Muslim-majority, predominantly Sunni; constitution recognizes multiple religions.
verifiers.role: Proposed contributor to a third-party Hezbollah-disarmament verification mechanism.
